nodes.title: Context Options
widgets_values:
## 🎞️ Longer Videos

👈 Enable this node if your video has more than **81 frames** and you're running into **OOM errors** or have **limited VRAM**.  
It automatically splits processing into chunks of 81 frames to keep things running smoothly. You can change this to 121 if you have enough vram for 121 frames. Keep the other settings as is!

nodes.title: FusionX Lora
widgets_values: 👈Increase to 1 and you can lower your steps to as low as 2 for super fast renders at the expense of a bit of quality

nodes.title: Context Options
widgets_values:
## ⚠️ Torch Compile Warning

👈 If your system doesn't support **Torch Compile**:  
- Set **Attention Mode** to `sdpa` in the model loader  
- **Bypass** THIS Torch Compile node
- Set **Base Precision** to `fp16` in the main model loader

nodes.title: Context Options
widgets_values:
## ⚠️ Block Swapping

👈 Useful for **low VRAM** or **OOM issues**.  
Start with bypass enabled, then gradually increase the **Swap Blocks** value (up to **40**) until stable.  

⚠️ Slower performance — avoid using if you have enough VRAM.

nodes.title: Sampler Setting Note
widgets_values:
## 🎬 Video Upscale & Enhancement

🔧 **Just Upscaling**  
No prompt + Denoise **0.3–0.5**  
➡️ Keeps original style, boosts quality

🎨 **Light Style Edits**  
Prompt + Denoise **0.7–0.8**  
➡️ Adds subtle creative changes

⚠️ **High Denoise = New Output**  
Above **0.85** generates new content  
No prompt = 🎲 unpredictable results

### 🟣 WAN Text Encoder
`umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.safetensors`

---
### ⚠️ Torch Compile Warning  
If your setup doesn’t support torch compile, set attention mode to `sdpa` in the model loader and bypas the Torch Compile settings and adjust the base_precision to just fp16

---

### ⚠️ Block Swapping
Block swapping helps if you have lower VRAM and/or get OOM. You can bypass it first and then update the blocks to swap to a higher number till you don't get OOM (up to 40) It will run slower so don't use if you have enough VRAM.

---

### ⚠️ Other known issues
If you get an error that has "FlowMatch" in it, please change your scheduler to uni_pc from FlowMatch_Causvid (or something else you like, dmp++_sde/beta is good too)
